chat.settings.help.api_key: Enter the API key required by the server’s --api-key option.
chat.settings.help.endpoint: Choose Open Responses or Chat Completions for API requests.
chat.settings.help.system_message: Instructions that guide the model’s responses.
chat.settings.help.show_system_message: Show the system message at the start of each conversation.
chat.settings.help.theme: Choose Light, Dark, or System to match your device.
chat.settings.help.paste_long_text_to_fi: Paste text longer than this character count as a file. Set to 0 to turn this off.
chat.settings.help.copy_text_attachments: Copy text attachments as part of the message text. They won’t paste back as separate attachments.
chat.settings.help.samplers: Apply samplers in this order. Default: top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;temperature.
chat.settings.help.backend_sampling: Run supported samplers on the accelerator for faster sampling.
chat.settings.help.temperature: Higher values make responses more varied. Lower values make them more focused.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_r: Set how far the temperature can vary based on token uncertainty.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_e: Adjust how token uncertainty changes the temperature.
chat.settings.help.top_k: Consider only the K most likely tokens.
chat.settings.help.top_p: Consider tokens whose combined probability reaches P.
chat.settings.help.min_p: Exclude tokens below this fraction of the most likely token’s probability.
chat.settings.help.xtc_probability: Set the chance of excluding the most likely tokens. Set to 0 to disable XTC.
chat.settings.help.xtc_threshold: Only tokens above this probability can be excluded by XTC.
chat.settings.help.typical_p: Select tokens based on how their log probability differs from the expected value.
chat.settings.help.repeat_last_n: Number of recent tokens checked for repetition.
chat.settings.help.presence_penalty: Reduce the likelihood of tokens that already appear in the response.
chat.settings.help.frequency_penalty: Reduce the likelihood of tokens based on how often they appear in the response.
chat.settings.help.dry_multiplier: Set the strength of DRY repetition reduction.
chat.settings.help.dry_base: Set the base value used to calculate the DRY repetition penalty.
chat.settings.help.dry_allowed_length: Allow repeated sequences up to this length before applying a DRY penalty.
chat.settings.help.dry_penalty_last_n: Number of recent tokens checked for DRY repetition penalties.
chat.settings.help.max_tokens: Maximum tokens per response. Set to -1 for no limit.
chat.settings.help.custom_json: Additional API parameters in valid JSON.
chat.settings.help.show_thought_in_progr: Expand the reasoning section while a response is being generated.
chat.settings.help.show_tool_calls: Show tool names and arguments below assistant messages.
chat.settings.help.disable_reasoning_par: Send reasoning_format=none to keep reasoning in the model’s response text.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_output_switc: Show a switch on each message to view the raw model output.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_llm_output: Show output without server processing or Markdown formatting.
chat.settings.help.keep_stats_visible: Keep response statistics visible after generation finishes.
chat.settings.help.show_message_stats: Show token count, speed, and duration below each response.
chat.settings.help.ask_for_title_confirm: Ask before changing the title when you edit the first message.
chat.settings.help.parse_pdf_as_image: Process PDF pages as images. Models without image support receive extracted text.
chat.settings.help.disable_auto_scroll: Keep the scroll position while a response is being generated.
chat.settings.help.render_user_content_a: Apply Markdown formatting to your messages.
chat.settings.help.always_show_sidebar_o: Keep the sidebar visible on larger screens.
chat.settings.help.auto_show_sidebar_on_: Show the sidebar when you start a new conversation.
chat.settings.help.show_microphone_on_em: Show the microphone in an empty message field when the model supports audio.
chat.settings.help.py_interpreter_enable: Run Python code blocks using Pyodide.
chat.settings.help.enable_continue_gener: Show Continue on assistant messages. Requires a model without reasoning support.
